title: Column eyebrow
description: A small uppercase monospaced tag on a faint tinted chip with a hairline edge, in the section's accent colour, optionally followed by a blinking block cursor like a terminal prompt.
notes: tone picks the accent token (primary, highlight, chart-1…5); also exports ColumnTone and toneVar() for the site's other blocks
the cursor blink is CSS; it stays solid under reduced motion
name: column-eyebrow

props.name: tone
props.description: accent colour of the text and the tinted chip

props.name: cursor
props.description: show a blinking block cursor after the label
